# Luxfer Holdings Announces Completion of Acquisition by Wynnchurch Capital


### 19 November 2026


**RIVERSIDE, CA — November 19, 2026 —** Luxfer Holdings PLC announced that its acquisition by affiliates of Wynnchurch Capital, L.P. was completed effective November 19, 2026. Luxfer is now a privately held company and will continue to operate under the Luxfer brand.


_


Luxfer has built a strong reputation for engineering expertise, innovation, and delivering high-performance materials and solutions to customers around the world. The company's success reflects the dedication of its employees, the trust of its customers, and its longstanding relationships with suppliers and other stakeholders. No disruptions to normal business operations are expected in the ownership transition.


Andy Butcher, Chief Executive Officer of Luxfer, commented:


*“Wynnchurch Capital’s experience investing in industrial businesses and operational resources provide an opportunity to build on Luxfer's strong foundation. We are excited to move forward and our commitment to our customers, to our employees and to delivering innovative, high-quality solutions remains unchanged.”*


With Wynnchurch as its new owner, Luxfer will remain focused on serving its customers, advancing its capabilities and strengthening its position in the markets where it operates.


[For additional information, please see \[Wynnchurch's official closing announcement\].](https://www.wynnchurch.com/news/wynnchurch-capital-completes-take-private-acquisition-of-luxfer-holdings-plc)
